events.title: Demo Update: New Hats, Scoring System, and Tons of Improvements!
events.summary: Hey everyone! We've been quietly updating the demo over the past few months (while also working on the full game), and we just released another update! For us, the demo has always been a work in progress. We've been using it as a live playtest, seeing how people play, and getting feedback. events.title: DEMO RELEASE ON MAY 12th
events.summary: IT’S FINALLY TIME. We are officially committing to releasing the No Wings Required demo on May 12th. Right now, we’re doing the final rounds of testing for the Mac build, so unless something new suddenly explodes (PLEASE don’t explode), there shouldn’t be any more delays. events.title: LOOK MOM, WE'RE LIVE!
events.summary: Thank you so much for stopping by and taking a look at our page. It has been a huge journey for us to get to this point and we’re super excited to be able to share our game. If No Wings Required feels like a game for you, please consider adding it to your Wishlist to stay updated. It truly helps a lot and means the world to us. 🙂
